name: Stochastic Three Periods
summary: This EA uses Stochastic oscillator signals across three different timeframes to generate trading decisions. It combines multi-period Stochastic readings to confirm trend direction and identify overbought/oversold entry points. Trades are opened when all three timeframe Stochastics align in the same direction, providing a filtered multi-timeframe confirmation system.
summary_zh: 该EA使用三个不同周期的随机指标(Stochastic)信号来生成交易决策。它结合多周期随机指标读数来确认趋势方向并识别超买/超卖入场点。当三个周期的随机指标方向一致时开仓，提供过滤后的多周期确认交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多周期随机指标共振原理，利用三个不同时间周期的Stochastic指标来过滤假信号。入场条件要求三个时间周期的Stochastic指标方向一致——做多时所有周期Stochastic从超卖区向上交叉，做空时从超卖区向下交叉。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及Stochastic指标反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面缺乏复合头寸管理，仅使用简单的一次性开仓模式。该策略的核心优势在于多周期共振过滤能有效减少假信号，但同时也可能导致入场机会过少。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-timeframe Stochastic resonance, using Stochastic oscillators from three different timeframes to filter out false signals. Entry conditions require all three timeframe Stochastics to align in the same direction — for long entries, all Stochastics cross upward from oversold zones, and for short entries, all cross downward from overbought zones. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as reverse Stochastic crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management lacks compounding position sizing, relying solely on simple one-time entry mode. The core strength of this strategy is that multi-timeframe resonance filtering effectively reduces false signals, but it may also result in too few trading opportunities.

pros: 多周期共振过滤有效减少假信号和频繁交易
Stochastic指标对震荡市场的超买超卖识别较为准确
三重确认机制提高了入场信号的质量和可靠性
策略逻辑清晰，参数可调性强，便于优化
pros_en: Multi-timeframe resonance filtering effectively reduces false signals and overtrading
Stochastic oscillator accurately identifies overbought/oversold conditions in ranging markets
Triple confirmation mechanism improves entry signal quality and reliability
Clear strategy logic with adjustable parameters facilitates optimization
cons: 三重确认条件过于严格，可能导致交易机会稀少
固定手数仓位管理缺乏风险自适应能力
Stochastic在强趋势市场中容易产生虚假反转信号
缺乏追踪止损机制，无法在趋势行情中最大化利润
没有考虑点差和滑点对剥头皮交易的影响
cons_en: Triple confirmation conditions are overly strict, potentially leading to scarce trading opportunities
Fixed lot position sizing lacks risk-adaptive capability based on account equity
Stochastic tends to produce false reversal signals in strong trending markets
Lack of trailing stop mechanism prevents profit maximization in trending moves
No consideration of spread and slippage impact on trading performance
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率调整手数
添加追踪止损功能以在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
引入趋势过滤器（如均线方向）避免在强趋势中逆势交易
增加点差过滤条件，避免在高点差时段开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity and ATR volatility
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trends
Introduce a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trades in strong trends
Add spread filter condition to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods

risk_points: 固定手数不根据账户资金调整，存在过度杠杆风险
Stochastic在单边行情中容易反复产生错误信号导致连续亏损
缺乏最大回撤控制和每日亏损限制机制
三周期共振虽减少假信号但也可能错过快速行情
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without account equity adjustment poses over-leveraging risk
Stochastic tends to generate repeated false signals in one-directional markets leading to consecutive losses
Lack of maximum drawdown control and daily loss limit mechanisms
While triple timeframe resonance reduces false signals, it may also miss fast-moving market opportunities
